[Act: cpc
 Chapter: Suits in Particular Cases
 Section: 79::Suits by or against Government.
]


In a suit by or against the Government, the authority to be named as plaintiff or defendant, as the case may be, shall be—
(a) in the case of a suit by or against the Central Government, 4[the Union of India], and (b) in the case of a suit by or against a State Government, the State.]
